chapter: Bud Scott band instrumentation and repertoire
title: Saxophone comes in after World War I and Bud's son
summary: He places the sax a year or two after the war, when Bud's son got one; the son died in the fire and Griffin now plays piano.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: When did the saxophone get the pop-up order on you? About...
Let's see. I don't know exactly... I don't know exactly when. The day, the date or the year even down. I don't know.
After... Was it before the First World War or after? Or during?

After the First World War, because we didn't have... And, uh, during the First World War, the band was... I know we were all eligible then for the Army. And we didn't stay. And, uh, just, I guess, a year or two later, Sax began to come in, because his son was just getting organized into the band. And that's just about the time, I guess, a few years later before, he gave his son a saxophone.

He got destroyed in the fire. I didn't know that. That, that, that was this band, the band. And, uh, his madam, she won't take it over and handle it. But, uh, now Griffin, the boy here now that, going in the band playing piano, he's here. He's working, uh, just, he's entertaining. He can sing, and he work by himself. He do mostly all the, uh, jobs and, around here now, right now. He's here. He's about your size. Not as big as Bud, though, huh? Not quite as big as Bud. There's lots of people thought that he was playing piano when, uh, after Percy was playing guitar. Then he'd taken piano. He wasn't quite as big as Bud. There's lots of people thought that he was Bud's son. But he wasn't. He's here now, and, uh, I don't know why he's... He's entertaining somewhere at some of these clubs here now.
